# Codex protocol fixture provenance

`thread-settings-updated-0.170.0.json` is a sanitized, schema-derived example,
not a claimed wire capture. The source is the versioned schema generated by
`codex-cli 0.170.0` using `codex app-server generate-json-schema --experimental`:
`v2/ThreadSettingsUpdatedNotification.json`, including its `ThreadSettings`
definition. The operation is the app-server `thread/settings/updated`
notification. Names, paths, and values are illustrative. This frame tests only
the model and effort fields explicitly defined on `threadSettings`.

`thread-start-response-0.170.0.json` is likewise a sanitized schema-derived
example, from the same executable's generated `v2/ThreadStartResponse.json`.
It represents the `thread/start` result, including the top-level `model` and
`reasoningEffort` fields. Its values are illustrative; it is not a wire capture.
